name: Manoj Vaibhav Gems N Jewellers Limited

facts.business: Manoj Vaibhav Gems 'N' Jewellers Limited is a leading regional jewellery retailer in South India with a network of 21 showrooms across Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, offering gold, diamond, silver, and precious stone jewellery.
key_risks: High value and nature of inventory could lead to significant risk of loss
